feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 August 2026 4:40pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 04 August 2026 at 4:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the west of Scotland, tracking slowly northeastwards.


##Wind##

South or southwest veering west early tonight force 4 or 5, occasionally 6 overnight. Increasing west or southwest 5 or 6 by dawn on Wednesday, before increasing 6 or 7 during the morning, then decreasing 5 or 6 again later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate tonight, and moderate or rough Wednesday morning.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, small risk of mist patches later this evening. Showers in the west of the area at first slowly moving eastwards, then becoming more scattered tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, perhaps moderate in any mist patches this evening and in any showers later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, soon veering west or northwest, decreasing 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Scattered showers merging into a longer spell of rain for a time before clearing to isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
